description: Rename a series, change its accounts (account_ids), hashtags, weekly target or video styles (style_ids), or archive it (archived: true). Episodes keep their numbers.

account_id.description: Older way to give one account; account_ids wins when both are given.

account_ids.description: The accounts the series runs on; picking the series in the composer fills Post to with them. Its numbers are compared with those accounts' other posts. [] clears them.

hashtags.description: Tags every episode should carry, e.g. ["#marketprep"]

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

per_week.description: How many episodes a week you aim for

style_ids.description: Video styles (library_list kind style) the series follows, in order; replaces the set, [] clears it. When a series has several, the one that serves the post's format family is used.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: series_update
title: Edit a series
